name: Saboo Sodium Chloro Limited
about: Saboo Sodium Chloro Limited manufactures and sells salt in India. The company offers salt under the Surya, Saboo, Himalayan, and Tota brands for chloro alkali, fisheries, and textiles and dying industries. It also provides various spices, such as turmeric and red chili powders, cumin seeds, fennel powders, coriander and fenugreek seeds, nutmeg, mace, pepper, and turmeric, as well as offers tea under the DOUBLE TOTA brand name. In addition, the company operates hotels and resorts, as well as solar and wind energy generation. It also exports its products to Papua New Guinea, Mauritius, Korea, Malaysia, Dubai, Bangladesh, Kenya, and Ghana. Saboo Sodium Chloro Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Jaipur, India.
